question: What is the annual retention rate of legislators who began their first term between January 1, 1917 and December 31, 1999, measured as the proportion of this cohort still in office on December 31st for each of the first 20 years following their initial term start? The results should show all 20 periods in sequence regardless of whether any legislators were retained in a particular year.
sql:
-- Alternative approach: join cohort with terms and check overlap
WITH first_terms AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) as first_term_start
  FROM legislators_terms
  GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start::DATE as first_term_start
  FROM first_terms
  WHERE first_term_start >= '1917-01-01' AND first_term_start <= '1999-12-31'
),
year_offsets AS (
  SELECT k as year_offset FROM generate_series(1, 20) AS t(k)
),
-- For each cohort member and year offset, compute the check date
check_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    c.id_bioguide,
    c.first_term_start,
    y.year_offset,
    (c.first_term_start + CAST(y.year_offset AS INTEGER) * INTERVAL '1 year')::DATE as check_date
  FROM cohort c
  CROSS JOIN year_offsets y
),
-- For each check, find if any term covers that date
retained AS (
  SELECT 
    cd.id_bioguide,
    cd.year_offset,
    cd.check_date,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN lt.term_start::DATE <= cd.check_date AND lt.term_end::DATE >= cd.check_date THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
  FROM check_dates cd
  LEFT JOIN legislators_terms lt ON lt.id_bioguide = cd.id_bioguide
  GROUP BY cd.id_bioguide, cd.year_offset, cd.check_date
)
SELECT 
  year_offset,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(retained) as retained_count,
  1.0 * SUM(retained) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
FROM retained
GROUP BY year_offset
ORDER BY year_offset

WITH first_terms AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) as first_term_start
  FROM legislators_terms

  WHERE first_term_start >= '1917-01-01' AND first_term_start <= '1999-12-31'

retention AS (
  SELECT 
    c.id_bioguide,
    c.first_term_start,
    (c.first_term_start + INTERVAL '1 year')::DATE as check_date,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (

      AND lt.term_start::DATE <= (c.first_term_start + INTERVAL '1 year')::DATE
      AND lt.term_end::DATE >= (c.first_term_start + INTERVAL '1 year')::DATE
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
  FROM cohort c
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as cohort_size, SUM(retained) as retained_count, 1.0 * SUM(retained) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
